$comment: A minimal encoder map — the shape of stardust/import/<archetype-slug>/vocabulary.json. One per template, authored at C-archetype by the archetype's subagent from the gated archetype's delivered document and its committed capture (importer-recipe.md § The map, § Encoder contract) — no instrument writes it; migrate.mjs plan derives the slot map only. Copy this file, set archetype and inputs, then replace every selector with the capture's own (never delivered text, never a condition on slug or URL). Keys: encode-map.schema.json; semantics: scripts/encode/engine.mjs; checks: encode.mjs --lint.

inputs.$comment: what the map was authored against; --lint fails while the recorded sha differs from the file and prints the current one

markers.$comment: a block with fixed cells: each cell a selector inside the module; parts stack several sources into one cell; optional parts may be absent
a block with repeated rows: rows selects each row inside the module, cells apply per row
a variant: the token is added to the block name when the module matches `when`
default content: the module's own markup, no block
a section style: the container's modules are walked, the section gets the style
a module the delivered page does not carry: drop names the reason; dynamics names the dynamics row that delivers it
markers.emitter: drop:runtime form, delivered by a dynamics row
